title: Home page shows unauthenticated state and sign-in entry point
description: Verifies the home page loads and indicates the user is not authenticated before any sign-in action.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify an unauthenticated state is displayed

title: Login page loads and offers Google sign-in action
description: Verifies the login page loads its primary content and provides a way to initiate Google sign-in.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Verify a Google sign-in action is available

title: Initiate Google sign-in from login page (in-app start)
description: Verifies that starting the Google sign-in flow triggers an authentication-in-progress state from the UI perspective.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Click the Google sign-in button
Verify the app shows an authentication-in-progress state

title: Logout from home returns to unauthenticated state (when available)
description: Verifies that if the UI exposes logout, using it returns the app to an unauthenticated state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the logout control if it is available
Verify an unauthenticated state is displayed

title: Canceling or failing sign-in shows an authentication error on login page
description: Verifies that an authentication attempt that does not complete results in an error message shown on the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Click the Google sign-in button
Wait for the authentication attempt to complete or return to the app
Verify an authentication error message is displayed

title: Reorder page loads primary input and run controls
description: Verifies the main reorder tool page loads with the text input area and actions to run models.

steps.description: Navigate to /reorder
Verify a text input area for reordering is displayed
Verify controls to run reordering are displayed

title: Run parsing reordering end-to-end and display results
description: Verifies submitting text for parsing reordering produces visible result outputs on the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /reorder
Fill sample text into the reordering input
Click the control to run parsing reordering
Verify reordering results are displayed as a table and cards

title: Run baseline reordering end-to-end and display results
description: Verifies submitting text for baseline reordering produces visible result outputs on the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /reorder
Fill sample text into the reordering input
Click the control to run baseline reordering
Verify baseline results are displayed as a table and cards

title: Load an example, compare both models, and show side-by-side outputs
description: Verifies loading an example populates the input and comparing both models displays both outputs for comparison.

steps.description: Navigate to /reorder
Click the control to load an example text
Verify the reordering input is populated with example text
Click the control to compare both models
Verify side-by-side comparison outputs are displayed

title: Submitting empty text shows input validation error
description: Verifies the UI prevents or reports invalid submission when the input is empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /reorder
Fill empty text into the reordering input
Click the control to run reordering
Verify an input validation error is visible

title: History page loads and displays run list or empty state
description: Verifies the history page loads and renders either a populated table or an empty state message.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Verify the run history table is displayed or an empty history state is displayed

title: Create a run from reorder page and see it appear in history
description: Verifies completing a reorder run results in a new entry that is visible when navigating to the history page.

steps.description: Navigate to /reorder
Fill uniquely identifiable text into the reordering input
Click the control to run reordering
Click the link to view run history
Verify a run entry containing the uniquely identifiable text is displayed in history

title: Delete a specific run from history and confirm it is removed
description: Verifies deleting an item removes it from the history list in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /reorder
Fill uniquely identifiable text into the reordering input
Click the control to run reordering
Click the link to view run history
Click delete for the run entry containing the uniquely identifiable text
Verify the run entry containing the uniquely identifiable text is no longer displayed

title: Clear full history and confirm empty state
description: Verifies clearing history removes all run entries and shows an empty state.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Click the clear history control
Verify an empty history state is displayed
